records.statement: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "product_search_vector_halfvec_idx" ON "mosaic_search"."product_listing" USING hnsw ((embedding::halfvec(1024)) halfvec_cosine_ops) WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 200)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "product_search_vector_binary_idx" ON "mosaic_search"."product_listing" USING hnsw ((binary_quantize(embedding)::bit(1024)) bit_hamming_ops) WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 200)

relabelled.note: Relabelled on 2026-10-13 to the catalog's current index, table and schema names, without re-measuring. Those were catalog-only renames (ALTER INDEX/TABLE ... RENAME, SET SCHEMA) of the same index and table; docs/current-scale-benchmarks.md lists them.
